description.value: Nicomen Lake is a hike-in backcountry campsite in E.C. Manning Park's Cascade Mountains, accessible only on foot more than 1 km from any road; a $5-per-person nightly permit is required, no reservations needed, and the high-elevation season is short.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record tags this as a backcountry camp site (backcountry=yes, tents=yes, capacity:tents=6) within E.C. Manning Park. The BC Parks website confirms Nicomen Lake is one of several designated backcountry campgrounds in the park, requiring an overnight permit; it is not listed among the three campgrounds that accept reservations (Buckhorn, Kicking Horse, Frosty Creek). The website provides no Nicomen Lake-specific amenity details beyond its existence as a permit-required backcountry campground, so most optional amenities remain null.
concerns: No physical address or GPS-navigable address available in OSM or on the website for the campground itself.
No phone number in OSM; general BC Parks contact line is referenced on the website but not specific to this campground.
Website covers all E.C. Manning Park backcountry campgrounds collectively; no Nicomen Lake-specific amenity details are provided, leaving most optional amenities unverifiable.
Park has no cellphone service per website; cyclists should plan accordingly for emergencies.

Nicomen Lake is not listed among the three campgrounds (Buckhorn, Kicking Horse, Frosty Creek) that accept peak-season reservations, strongly implying permit-only first-come access, but this is not stated explicitly for Nicomen Lake.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Nicomen Lake Campground is an active, legitimate BC Parks backcountry campsite relevant to bikepacking and self-supported touring cyclists traversing E.C. Manning Park in the Cascade Mountains.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM records capacity at 6 tent sites. A backcountry permit is required for all overnight stays; permits can be registered online at camping.bcparks.ca, by phone, or in person at the Manning Park visitor centre, Manning Park Lodge, or Lightning Lake gatehouse.

wow_evidence: hike-in backcountry campsite… accessible only on foot more than 1 km from any road
